summary: Keep shipped label descriptions within GitHub's 100-character limit and make label sync continue after per-label failures (#1200).
migration_impact: Pull updated `.github/labels.yml` (or run import-payload) so bootstrap label sync succeeds. Bootstrap scripts truncate over-long descriptions with a warning and report failed labels without skipping later steps.
migration_guidance: 1. Sync `.github/labels.yml` from plate-core or shorten any local label descriptions to 100 characters or fewer.
2. Re-run `scripts/bootstrap_github.sh` or `gh plate bootstrap --apply` if a prior run stopped during label sync.
agent_notes: Use `plate_core.github_labels.GITHUB_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH` and the shipped-labels unittest when editing labels.yml. Do not rely on GitHub to accept descriptions over 100 characters.
